## What's New in v1.5.4

### ⚡ 100% Update Check Reliability Fix
- **User-Agent Header Added:** GitHub API blocks or returns 403 Forbidden to requests without a `User-Agent` header. Added full custom `User-Agent` headers across all HTTP requests.
- **Multi-Tier CDN Fallback:** App now checks raw CDN (`raw.githubusercontent.com`) first, bypassing GitHub API 60 req/hr IP rate limits on mobile carrier networks.
- **Resilient Fallback Chain:** If CDN is unreachable, automatically falls back to GitHub API endpoints.
